Attached: 1 image

The part I always missed in backup tools: config that does not make me read the docs five times.

So I built an interactive generator for my Docker backup setup. Pick the engine, host, interval, retention and compression. It writes the compose service plus a separate .env for credentials.

Bookmark it, the tool is at the end of the post.

https://danielpetrica.com/posts/easy-database-backups-with-docker-compose#database-backup-configurator

#Docker #DevOps #SelfHosted
